title: Marie Curie
text:
Marie Curie was born in Warsaw in 1867. She was a scientist. She studied physics and chemistry in Paris. She wanted to learn more about science.

In 1898, Marie and her husband Pierre found a new element. They called it radium. Marie won the Nobel Prize two times. She died in 1934.

questions.text: What did Marie and Pierre find in 1898?
Why did Marie go to Paris?
options: She wanted to learn more about science
She wanted to become a singer
She wanted to open a shop

questions.text: What can we guess about Marie Curie's work?
options: It was not useful to anyone

vocabulary.definition: a person who studies science as a job
a basic substance that cannot be broken into simpler substances
something good that you get for winning a competition
the man that a woman is married to

paragraph_translations: Maria Skłodowska-Curie urodziła się w Warszawie w 1867 roku. Była naukowcem. Studiowała fizykę i chemię w Paryżu. Chciała dowiedzieć się więcej o nauce.
W 1898 roku Maria i jej mąż Piotr odkryli nowy pierwiastek. Nazwali go radem. Maria dwukrotnie zdobyła Nagrodę Nobla. Zmarła w 1934 roku.
